Lemma
[standard-solution curvature blow-up at maximal time] Source: cao-zhu ↗ lem:cz-standard-solution-spatial-curvature-comparison 1. Claim 2 in the proof of Proposition 7.3.3\group Ricci Flow with Surgery Suppose $T<\frac{n-1}{2}$. Fix a point $x_{0}\in \mathbb {R}^{n} $, then there is a $\delta >0$, such that for any $x\in M$ with $d_{0}(x,x_{0})\geq \delta ^{-1}$, we have \[ R(x,t)\leq 2C+\frac{n-1}{\frac{n-1}{2}-t}\quad \text{ for all }\; t\in [0,T), \] where $C$ is the constant in (7.3.5).
